00:52:59	Kevaundray Wedderburn:	Replying to "At some point isn't ..."

Migration for the irregular stf:

Users continue like today and when we hit the pq fork, their bls deposits revert and they will need to call the same contract but a different function “deposit_pq”

Migration for new contract:

Users will migrate today to the new deposit contract and will be given N months to do so
When we hit the pq fork, bls deposits will be reverted and they will need to use the pq equivalent method
